comment: The text states that the formal architecture can become a set of criteria against which a candidate architecture is checked for completeness and consistency. However, the criteria, validation rules, and minimum mandatory relationships are not defined in this section.

anchor.note: p.42 l.Lines 49-55 read as the printed page; section 3.1 agrees

public.text: The text states that the formal architecture can become a set of criteria against which a candidate architecture is checked for completeness and consistency. However, the criteria, validation rules, and minimum mandatory relationships are not defined in this section.
public.suggestedRevision: Cross-reference the specific conformance rules in Section 3.7 and identify which checks can be automated, which require expert review, and which elements or relationships are mandatory for a valid national mapping.
